DPI Engine

Zero-dependency Packet Intelligence

Engineered raw byte-level packet parsing using Python struct — Ethernet → IPv4 → TCP/UDP with TLS SNI extraction before handshake. Trained a behavioral Random Forest on 4,150 traffic samples for real-time classification of 10+ concurrent flows. No third-party parsing library needed.

About me

A little bit
about me

I'm Aditya Pandey — B.Tech CSE (AI & ML), MIPS Kanpur, Semester 4, Class of 2028. Born and raised in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

I got into AI not because of the hype — but because I wanted to understand how machines can be made to genuinely understand human context, not just process text. That question became MEMET.

My primary language is Python. I don't list tools I've only seen tutorials about. What's on my stack, I can explain, use, and rebuild from first principles.

Six real projects built — three live and deployed. The gap between where I am and most students isn't about knowing more libraries. It's about thinking differently about problems.
